source: Aucune maquette classée « autre » : gabarit générique déduit des styles communs les plus fréquents des 84 documents (lumière naturelle douce, grain argentique, espace négatif, palette restreinte) et des motifs de rôles qui ont le mieux tenu (iprof, tonchemindevie, gwenanou-print, dbl-avocat).
style: Modern editorial documentary photograph, natural soft light, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, calm composition with generous negative space, photorealistic, high detail.
interdits: No product, no artwork, no document or screen with readable content, no place presented as the client's real premises, no stock-photo cliché, no handshake, nobody looking at the camera.
evite: Évite tout ce qui pourrait passer pour une réalisation, un produit ou un lieu réel du client : lumière, matières, objets de travail vierges et personnes de dos.

404.consigne: A single everyday object left alone on an empty table, soft side light, a long shadow, large calm empty space, a gentle touch of humour.
404.evite: L'objet cassé ou la scène d'échec.

ouverture.consigne: Wide calm view of {sujet} in soft early light, a single clear subject placed off-centre, gentle haze, minimal and uncluttered.
ouverture.source: motif commun des ouvertures (instinct-aventure, elka, loeilsingulier)
ouverture.evite: La scène chargée sous le titre.

section-fond.consigne: Close-up of soft natural linen draped in gentle folds on a pale wooden surface, morning sunlight crossing it with delicate leaf shadows, lots of calm negative space.
section-fond.evite: Les détails nets sous le texte.

scene-metier.consigne: Still life of {sujet} on a wooden table, an open notebook with blank pages and a pencil, a cup of coffee, morning light, tidy and honest, nothing readable.
scene-metier.source: iprof et francis-gerardin (objets de travail vierges)

lieu.consigne: A calm, tidy, empty room in the morning, sheer white curtains slightly lifted by air, a wide beam of sunlight crossing the room with fine dust floating in it, light wooden floor, one green plant, nobody.

texture.consigne: Straight-on macro texture of {matieres}, evenly lit with soft raking light, filling the whole frame edge to edge, no objects.
texture.evite: Les objets qui cassent la texture.

portrait-generique.consigne: A person seen strictly from behind by a large window, softly backlit, shoulders and back only, face never visible, hands out of frame, quiet atmosphere.
